name: push_stroller
text: A person steadily walks straight forward pushing a baby stroller, with both hands continuously on the stroller handle in front of the abdomen. Elbows relaxed and bent, forearms extending forward. Regular alternating walking steps, upright torso, maintain both grips, no turning or releasing.

trim.reason: Middle complete gait cycle; removes transient end-cycle grip overshoot. No joint editing or time scaling.

review.reason: 前两次未通过；修正局部约束整组位移，并用骨段长度与旋转一致的稀疏手臂关键姿势重生。取中间完整周期，双手最大误差3.52、3.93厘米；正侧面和源手部近景已检查。
review.known_limitations: 源手指固定放松形状，不宣称精细抓握；映射脚尖最低约-0.78厘米；接缝姿势闭合，不承诺速度一阶连续。
review.constraint_note: 全身19/199帧、间隔11帧，另加局部双手约束。只裁剪完整周期，未修改生成的关节。

single_unit.reason: Keep the last complete authored whole-body cycle, with its original timing and root travel.
